program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (begin
             (define nine-row
               (find-first (lambda (r) (for/and ((c (range 0 w))) (= (at g r c) 9)))
                           (range 0 h)))
             (define result (cellmap g (r c v) v))
             (for* ((r (range 0 nine-row)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (when (= (at g r c) 5) (set! result (set-cell result r c 7))))
             (for* ((r (range (+ nine-row 1) h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (when (= (at g r c) 6) (set! result (set-cell result r c 7))))
             (define six-mask (cellmap g (r c v) (if (and (> r nine-row) (= v 6)) 1 0)))
             (for-each (lambda (obj)
                         (define cells (obj-cells obj))
                         (define rs (map first cells))
                         (define cs (map second cells))
                         (define minr (min-list rs))
                         (define maxr (max-list rs))
                         (define minc (min-list cs))
                         (define maxc (max-list cs))
                         (define bh (+ 1 (- maxr minr)))
                         (define bw (+ 1 (- maxc minc)))
                         (define chosen
                           (if (> bh bw)
                               (if (and (< maxr (- h 1)) (= (at g (+ maxr 1) minc) 2))
                                   (list maxr minc)
                                   (if (and (> minr 0) (= (at g (- minr 1) minc) 2))
                                       (list minr minc)
                                       (list maxr minc)))
                               (if (and (> minc 0) (= (at g minr (- minc 1)) 2))
                                   (list minr minc)
                                   (if (and
                                         (< maxc (- w 1))
                                         (= (at g minr (+ maxc 1)) 2))
                                       (list minr maxc)
                                       (list minr minc)))))
                         (define rr (first chosen))
                         (define cc (second chosen))
                         (define ref-r (- (* 2 nine-row) rr))
                         (set! result (set-cell result rr cc 2))
                         (when
                           (and (>= ref-r 0) (< ref-r nine-row))
                           (set! result (set-cell result ref-r cc 5))))
                       (objects six-mask 0))
             (for* ((r (range (+ nine-row 1) h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (when (= (at g r c) 2) (set! result (set-cell result r c 7))))
             result))))
